competitor: DeepSeek V4 Flash High interactive diagnostic

function.description: Perform one research controller action and receive its observed result on the next turn.
function.name: take_action

prompt: Solve the supplied research task independently. Choose informative experiments using only permitted public evidence. Submit reproducible code, fitted parameters and appropriately limited claims. First train the supplied reference baseline into artifact/ and request a controller development evaluation before custom code or exploratory analysis: load uses ridge, heat uses elapsed, pulse uses ridge. Then compare alternatives using development loss, retain the best valid candidate, and submit it. Training error alone is not development evidence.
